items.role: Senior Backend Developer – NestJS | AWS CLOUD
description: Implemented a secure Backoffice authentication module with AWS Cognito, OTP, and KMS, and automated cloud infrastructure using Pulumi (IaC).
Integrated digital wallet services with EEDE (Gmoney and Ligo) via Apache Kafka and webhooks, securing real-time transactions.
Optimized agent affiliation pipelines and contributed to end-to-end development of React Native mobile and React web backoffice apps.
Accelerated development workflows leveraging AWS Kiro Code Agent, Amazon Q (Sonnet, Opus) and custom MCP extensions.
Implemented microservices dedicated to the auditing of contracts and subcontracts.
Developed an inspection module to audit workers under CODELCO regulations.
Updated the company's shared npm package @sucal/shared, adding interfaces, helper classes, reusable functions, and a PDF creation template.
Generated automated and structured PDF reports for compliance tracking.
Developed microservices for document and image uploading to AWS S3 using presigned URLs with the AWS SDK.

items.role: Senior Backend Developer – NodeJS | AWS | Serverless
description: Developed and maintained microservices for a corporate wellness platform (EstarBien).
Utilized Serverless Framework with AWS Lambda, S3, SNS, SQS, and SES services.
Applied DDD (Domain-Driven Design) and Hexagonal Architecture principles to decouple business logic.
Developed unit and integration tests using BDD methodologies (Gherkin, Jest).
Built Lambda functions for on-demand and bulk email delivery integrated with NodeJS, SES, SQS, and SNS.
Integrated microservices with ContentStack webhooks for dynamic and real-time content management on the EstarBien platform.
Optimized notification components utilizing AWS Lambda and Redis Cache for fast delivery.
Developed scalable microservices using Express, MongoDB, and Redis.
Implemented authentication mechanisms using Cognito and AWS CDK for fleet management systems in the US.
Developed a web-based auto insurance quoting application using VueJS, Pinia, and TypeScript.
Rimac Seguros Client.
Created Lambda functions for the automated loading of NPS customer satisfaction surveys.
Developed Lambda functions exposed via AWS API Gateway for integration with Salesforce platforms.
Validated entity data structures and mapped core APIs for Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Transferred and synced data from GCP to Salesforce using Google Cloud Functions in Python, Cloud Scheduler, and Skyvia.
Developed microservices with Spring Boot to enable Spain as an origin country for international money transfers.
Utilized AWS CodeCommit, RDS, API Gateway, CodePipeline, and CloudWatch for secure cloud deployments and monitoring.
Implemented Liquibase for database schema migration management and Retrofit for external integrations.
Implemented a microservice integrated with Google Sheets to update system tables in real time.
Built REST APIs for merchant payment solutions, BCP's Mobile Banking application, and auxiliary financial systems.
Designed and developed business, application, and channel-tier microservices.
